description: Identify a vehicle from its VIN and check for safety recalls before a purchase, listing, insurance quote or repair. Decodes a 17-character VIN with NHTSA vPIC (make, model, year, trim, body, engine, fuel, drive, transmission, plant, check-digit validation) and lists NHTSA recall campaigns for that make, model and year. Recalls are per model, not VIN-specific. Use when a VIN is all you have; coverage is best for US-market vehicles. $0.003 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: vin_decode
